question: What attainment results from chanting the mantra four hundred thousand times?
premises: The mantra is chanted four hundred thousand times.
Such chanting produces a specific attainment.
The attained state is lordship over speech.
inference: Chanting the mantra four hundred thousand times makes one a great lord of speech.
plain_english: By chanting the mantra four hundred thousand times, one becomes a great lord of speech.
